content:
lucy: Heads-up: i'm opening a docs PR to add an 'Offline installer: KMS proxy migration + IPv6 notes' section. It includes a tiny Node.js SDK snippet, systemd restart guidance for the installer, checksums for offline bundles, and a short IPv6/SNAT caveat for private VPCs. Looking for one infra and one docs reviewer.

diego: sounds useful. can you include a minimal Node.js check and a sample systemd override to ensure the installer picks up env vars on restart? also call out any env var renames.

lucy: PR draft here: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/5274 (draft). Changes: rename OLD_KMS_PROXY -> KMS_PROXY_URL, add TLS_CA_PATH/TLS_CLIENT_CERT env vars, add Node.js/golang/python snippets, add systemd snippet, and a short IPv6 note about SNAT behavior in dual-stack clusters.

samir: IPv6 note is important. NAT66 is rare and many on-prem NAT gateways don't handle fragment reassembly the same way as IPv4. we should recommend testing both IPv4 and IPv6 paths and include a quick `ping6` + `curl -6` sanity check in the doc.

kb-bot: automated link-check: found 1 outdated link in /installers/airgap_guide.md -> /docs/old_kms_flags.md. Suggest updating anchor to /private/kms-proxy.md#env-vars or removing.

diego: update the anchor and add a small migration paragraph: "If you previously used --use_kms_proxy, set KMS_PROXY_URL and TLS_CA_PATH. For systemd-managed installs, update the unit Environment and run `systemctl daemon-reload && systemctl restart redwood-installer.service`."

lucy: adding that exact text and a systemd snippet. will include a rollback step (unset KMS_PROXY_URL and restart) and a brief deprecation timeline.

lucy: systemd override example to drop into `/etc/systemd/system/redwood-installer.service.d/env.conf`:

"""ini
[Service]
Environment=KMS_PROXY_URL=http://10.11.0.7:3128
Environment=TLS_CA_PATH=/etc/redwood/kms-ca.pem
"""

samir: nice. for the Node snippet can we include both env-from-process and explicit agent configuration? some operators prefer passing env inline during systemd start.

lucy: Node.js snippet added:

"""js
// minimal Node.js SDK proxy check
const https = require('https');
const url = require('url');
const proxy = process.env.HTTPS_PROXY || process.env.KMS_PROXY_URL;
const options = url.parse('https://kms.local/healthz');
if (proxy) { options.agent = new (require('https-proxy-agent'))(proxy); }
https.get(options, (res) => { console.log('status', res.statusCode); }).on('error', (e) => { console.error('err', e.message); });
"""

diego: add a small note about the https-proxy-agent dependency for offline installs (include the tarball checksum step for the node module if folks vendor it).

lucy: good call. adding a vendor checklist: include npm tarball in offline bundle and verify sha256. sample checksum command: `sha256sum node-module.tgz` and include the expected hash in the docs.

kb-bot: lint: please use triple backticks for fenced code blocks and include language tags. link-check: updated suggestion: replace /docs/old_kms_flags.md -> /private/kms-proxy.md#env-vars.

samir: add a tiny 'what to verify post-migration' checklist for support: grep installer logs for "kms: key fetch succeeded" and "kms: proxy handshake OK" and the example commands to run on customer env. also include expected error lines like `tls: handshake failure` and `connect: connection refused` so support can triage faster.

lucy: adding the grep examples: `journalctl -u redwood-installer -o short | grep "kms: key fetch"` and `grep -i "handshake" /var/log/redwood/installer.log`. also adding sample troubleshooting outputs: e.g., `ERROR: tls: handshake failure` and `ERROR: dial tcp: connection refused`.

diego: include an IPv6 sanity check: `ping6 kms.local` and `curl -6 --proxy "$HTTPS_PROXY" https://kms.local/healthz`. note: some HSM appliance vendors require specific PMTU settings for IPv6. recommend trying `ip -6 route change default mtu 1400` on the egress node as a troubleshooting step.

lucy: added IPv6 bullet and a short paragraph about dual-stack SNAT caveats for NAT44/NAT66 gateways.

ops-oncall: i'll validate the systemd/daemon-reload wording and run the Node.js and curl checks against our staging offline bundle. i'll also verify the checksum commands. ping me when PR is marked ready.

lucy: will split PR into two commits: (1) snippets + systemd + checks, (2) link fixes + migration/deprecation note + vendor checklist. planning to request reviews from @diego and @samir tomorrow morning. tagging ops after tests. thanks all. :white_check_mark:
